signed_rows.behavior: `kmaudit briefing --json` reports, per namespace, sections, pending sections, claims, checks by status and open feedback; sections, claims, check statuses and open feedback match what `kmaudit claims list` and `kmaudit checks list` report for that namespace, and pending is the count of sections whose page is new or changed. Without --json it prints a few lines per namespace and one next step.
signed_rows.fails_when: a namespace is missing, a matched count differs from the list commands, pending differs from the sections a fresh cut finds unextracted, or the text output names no next step while sections are pending

signed_rows.behavior: The briefing is read-only: with only an old .kmctl/audit.sqlite, or with stores under .kmaudit/, no store is created, copied or migrated (no .kmaudit/ appears where there was none) and every .sqlite file's bytes are unchanged; only SQLite's -wal and -shm sidecar files may appear. This holds even when a page changed since extraction, and the changed page's sections are counted pending.
signed_rows.fails_when: a .kmaudit/ folder or a new .sqlite file appears, any .sqlite file's bytes change, or the changed section is not counted pending

signed_rows.behavior: A section whose stored key was made under a hash in PREVIOUS_HASHES reads as up to date in the briefing, as the store's refresh would treat it.
signed_rows.fails_when: such a section is counted pending

signed_rows.behavior: In a repository with no namespace the briefing prints nothing and exits 0; with a store it cannot read it prints one line saying the briefing is unavailable and exits 0.
signed_rows.fails_when: either case exits nonzero, the empty case prints anything, or the broken case prints a traceback or more than one line

resigns.reason: plan review round 1: read-only means no store opened through Store (r2), and pending is the briefing's own count from the pages, not the list commands' (r1)
plan review round 2: read-only allows SQLite's -wal/-shm sidecars, since immutable=1 would miss rows running agents have not checkpointed (r2)
